thread:
maria: Heads-up: NVIDIA released patches affecting NCCL + cuDNN. Advisories reference CVE-2026-0421 (NCCL elevation) and CVE-2026-0422 (cuDNN OOB). Patch available for driver 530.x and cuDNN 8.7. We need triage and a rollout schedule for Dedicated + Private fleets.

alex: Thanks. Severity? exploitability? link?

maria: CVSS: 9.1 / high exploitability in multi-tenant setups. Advisory: https://nvidia.security/advisories/2026-03 (copy pasted link). Short: NCCL remote actor can misuse NCCL IPL to gain elevated container privileges; cuDNN has OOB read in RNN kernels.

jordan: Quick compatibility notes I checked: driver 530.41 patched, CUDA 12.1 ok, cuDNN 8.7.2 patched, NCCL 2.18.4 includes fix. Matrix: 530.x + CUDA 12.1/12.2 + cuDNN 8.7.x -> validated for our models.

samuel: For Private installs: driver blobs are signed at build. Do we need to re-sign via our KMS/HSM before deploy? Also any new kernel module signing requirements?

maria: Good call. For Dedicated (cloud) we can push vendor-signed packages. For Private, customers that enforce module-signing will need re-signed modules. Action: update KMS runbook, put HSM flow in customer onboarding ticket.

alex: Propose rollout: canary 10 nodes in dedicated-gpu-pool-2 tonight 22:00 UTC, 4h soak, then 10%/30%/60% stagger. Private installs: schedule per-customer, notify SEs. Rollback plan?

maria: Rollback = redeploy previous driver package + restart kubelet on affected nodes. Keep previous image cached. ETA for canary prep: 2 hours. Monitoring: nvml errors, kernel oops, pod OOMs, model-latency SLO.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-7623. Use: `./infra/tools/driver-deploy --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-2 --image nvidia/driver:530.41-patch`

jordan: Smoke tests to run post-upgrade:
```
# run a tiny NCCL all-reduce across 4 gpus
kubectl -n gpu-tools run -it nccl-smoke --image=nvcr.io/nccl-tests:2.17 -- /bin/bash -lc "./build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 8 -f 2 -g 4"
# quick cuDNN op sanity in python
kubectl -n gpu-tools exec -it nccl-smoke -- python -c \"import cupy; import sys; a=cupy.arange(1024); print(a.sum())\"
```

maria: Add telemetry checks to alert channel: driver_version mismatch, nvml error spikes, increased retry rate on model servers. Also update RBAC/audit: capture driver install events and node-restarts in audit logs.

samuel: I'll open a KMS task: ensure private customers have signing key instructions. Also check our key rotation schedule won't invalidate earlier signed packages.

security-bot: Created vuln ticket INC-3421 and linked to tracking board.

alex: If canary is clean, what's ETA to full fleet? ~8–12 hours with stagger and soak?

maria: Yes. Plan: canary tonight 22:00 UTC -> soak 4h -> 10% next-window -> 30% next 2h -> rest in final wave. Notify pager for any kernel oops.

infra-bot: Canary nodes provisioned: dedicated-gpu-pool-2-[1..10] tagged. Suspending autoscaler during deploy.

jordan: I'll run the compatibility smoke matrix across CUDA 12.0/12.1 on canary nodes after deploy and paste results.

maria: Great. If anything fails, capture `dmesg`, `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`, and `kubectl describe pod` before rollback. Postmortem if >30min outage. :thumbsup:

alex: ack. I'll coordinate on-call and update runbook with commands.

maria: Thanks — follow-up tomorrow with final validation matrix and notes for Private customers.
